band: 80% prediction interval [H*exp(p10), H*exp(p90)] with p10/p90 from the bin containing the predicted count H in band_by_region_class[set][region][class]; class = cell for an AOI of one 0.25° cell, agg for any aggregate of 2+ cells; region = region of the cells carrying the largest share of H, national for the whole country; set T before 2002-07, TA until 2011-12, none for observed VIIRS months; widen by |0.025*ONI| per side in reconstructed months. band_by_count = national pooled bins (reference only)
